label: 14–21 September 2026
title: Weekly Digest
subtitle: The week's main stories from your sources

stories.headline: Tech leaders push for AI slowdown as U.S. and China clash over regulation
stories.summary: Major AI companies are advocating for a slower development pace, while Trump labels opposition to AI as a conspiracy. The U.S. and China are in conflict over AI regulation amid global concerns about its impact on human rights.
stories.why_it_matters: The debate over AI regulation reflects broader geopolitical and ethical tensions with significant implications for technology development and human rights.
key_facts: Key AI executives from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI are calling for a slower pace of AI development.
Trump has dismissed concerns about AI, calling opposition a 'sick conspiracy' that benefits China.
The UN has warned that unchecked AI development could threaten human rights, including privacy and safety.
The U.S. and China are in a regulatory and technological rivalry over AI governance.

articles.title: Donald Trump acusa els empresaris que volen regular la IA de formar part d'una "conspiració de l'esquerra"
articles.summary: Donald Trump ha sortit en tromba contra aquells que volen regular la intel·ligència artificial. En una bateria de missatges a Truth Social, el president nord-americà responsabilitza les esquerres i els demòcrates d'escampar teories conspiranoiques malaltisses i amenaça d'emprendre accions legals contra les tecnològiques que vulguin regular-la pel seu compte. En aquests missatges, el magnat assegura que l'únic que cal per evitar mals majors és un president intel·ligent i fort . Es referia a ell mateix. Trump també ha parlat de Dario Amodei , d'Anthropic, una de les companyies nord-americanes d'IA. D'ell ha dit que ara juga a ser un angelet, però que per sort la Casa Blanca el va aturar perquè no fes un mal ús de la intel·ligència artificial. I remata: "No matem la gallina dels ous d'or!" A tot això, qui aquesta nit ha tornat a advertir dels perills de la IA és Jacob Coxon , extreballador d'Anthropic. Va plegar alarmat pels riscos de la intel·ligència artificial i aquesta nit en una entrevista a Fox News ha recordat que és l'únic avenç tecnològic capaç d'actuar sense rebre ordres de ningú. Això quan en les últimes hores, el mitjà nord-americà The information, especialitzat en…

articles.title: Donald Trump llama en directo a Jensen Huang (Nvidia): “Lo del peligro de la IA es un engaño”
articles.author: Francisco Bracero Osuna
articles.summary: “Los robots no van a conquistar el mundo. Eso no va a suceder”, afirma el presidente antes de exponer una curiosa teoría genética sobre por qué entiende de IA

articles.title: Un exinvestigador de Google se suma a las advertencias de que la IA podría “acabar con toda la humanidad”
articles.author: Reuters Reuters
articles.summary: A former Google researcher has joined warnings that artificial intelligence could potentially wipe out humanity. Public concern over AI dangers has risen following the recent resignation of Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon.

articles.title: La carrera entre EE.UU. y China por la IA frena cualquier intento de control
articles.author: Francesc Peiron Arques
articles.summary: The technological race between the United States and China over artificial intelligence is hindering regulatory efforts. Donald Trump opposes any AI regulation, despite suggestions from companies like OpenAI and Anthropic.

articles.title: Will Rinehart: “Un pacto para frenar la IA podría infringir la ley antimonopolio”
articles.author: Blanca Gispert Hernandez
articles.summary: American Enterprise Institute scholar Will Rinehart suggested that an agreement to slow down AI development could violate antitrust laws. He predicts a new phase of controlled technological progress.

articles.title: Alarma IA, fiebre Data Center
articles.author: Enric Juliana Ricart
articles.summary: Public alarm and intense focus on artificial intelligence coincide with growing public backlash against data center developments.

articles.title: Trump calls, interrupts Nvidia CEO to say AI fears are ‘a hoax’
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump makes a surprise call to Nvidia's CEO, interrupting a live event to discuss fears about AI.

articles.title: Les grans tecnològiques cauen a borsa, mentre Donald Trump rebaixa les preocupacions dels grans magnats de la IA
articles.summary: Major tech stocks fell globally, with the Nasdaq dropping nearly 1%, after AI industry leaders warned of future risks and urged a development slowdown. US President Donald Trump downplayed these concerns, while semiconductor firms suffered notable declines.

articles.title: IA: nada ha cambiado, todo debe cambiar
articles.author: Álvaro San Román
articles.summary: An opinion piece argues that recent calls by AI executives to slow development are disingenuous. The author contends that despite acknowledging the risks, developers remain committed to pushing forward their technological advancements.

articles.title: Por qué los dueños de la IA dan un giro de 180 grados y en qué consiste su propuesta de pisar el freno
articles.author: Adhik Arrilucea
articles.summary: Key executives from major AI companies, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI, have aligned in advocating for a slower pace of AI development. Following the debate, OpenAI has delayed its planned initial public offering.

articles.title: La IA se ha caído de un guindo
articles.author: Carme Artigas
articles.summary: AI industry leaders have recently united to urge a pause in development, but the White House rejected the idea, framing AI dominance as a geopolitical necessity. Critics view the tech industry's sudden focus on self-regulation with skepticism.

articles.title: ¿Se puede 'frenar' la IA? Por qué el resto del mundo desconfía del plan de Silicon Valley
articles.author: Carlos del Castillo
articles.summary: Leaders from top AI organizations have surprisingly agreed on the need to slow advanced AI research to ensure control. However, experts, foreign nations like China, and other stakeholders question Silicon Valley's intent and authority to set the pace.

articles.title: Las alertas sobre la IA sacuden unos mercados dependientes de la tecnología
articles.author: Piergiorgio Sandri
articles.summary: Recent warnings regarding artificial intelligence risks have unsettled financial markets heavily reliant on tech investments. The Bank for International Settlements noted that the sector harbors underlying vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Trump al·lega una «conspiració malaltissa» contra la IA i els centres de dades que la generen
articles.author: Pau Espí Solé
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump dismissed warnings from AI company executives, labeling opposition to AI and data centers a sick conspiracy that benefits China. He argued that a strong president is the only necessary safeguard for AI.

articles.title: Per què hi ha una allau d'alertes i por a la intel·ligència artificial?
articles.author: Agustí Sala
articles.summary: Prominent AI leaders have issued warnings about risks posed by untested models, sparking market anxieties. Experts suggest companies fear severe financial backlash if unverified technologies cause major real-world incidents.

articles.title: Nvidia lidera la caiguda a Wall Street per la por sobre la IA
articles.author: Gerard Mira Sánchez
articles.summary: Tech stocks led by Nvidia fell on Wall Street following fears around artificial intelligence development. Concerns grew after the resignation of Jacob Coxon and calls from Anthropic co-founder Dario Amodei for increased AI safety measures.

articles.title: Trump califica de “conspiración enfermiza” la oposición a la IA y dice que él es la barrera de protección
articles.author: Francesc Peiron Arques
articles.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has rejected calls to slow down artificial intelligence development, labeling opposition to AI a sick conspiracy. He argued that existing restrictions are sufficient and that limiting progress only benefits China.

articles.title: De la seguretat a la cursa comercial: la pugna EUA-Xina per la intel·ligència artificial generativa
articles.summary: The dispute over Anthropic has intensified the debate on generative AI regulation between the US and China. China supports regulatory oversight, whereas the United States opposes placing limits on the technology.

articles.title: EEUU y China se enfrentan en el debate sobre la regulación de la IA en plena carrera por su dominio
articles.author: EFE
articles.summary: The US and China are clashing over AI regulation amid competing for technological dominance. Donald Trump opposed new rules after tech leaders like Dario Amodei, Sam Altman, and Elon Musk advocated slowing advanced model development.

articles.title: Trump descarta nuevas regulaciones para la IA: "Hay una conspiración enfermiza"
articles.author: Andrés Gil
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump dismissed calls for new AI regulations following safety warnings from tech leaders and international bodies. The controversy flared up after engineer Jacob Coxon resigned from Anthropic over undisclosed risks in AI models.

articles.title: El debate de la inteligencia artificial: qué dicen sus cuatro líderes sobre frenar su desarrollo
articles.author: David Cuéllar del Rey
articles.summary: Prominent tech leaders are calling for caution regarding the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence. An essay by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposing slower development and stricter safety measures received backing from Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Demis Hassabis.

articles.title: La ONU alerta del peligro de la IA y pide regularla: "Todos los derechos humanos están en riesgo"
articles.author: David Romero González
articles.summary: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk warned that unchecked AI development poses existential threats to human rights, including health, privacy, and safety. His statement follows concerns raised by former Anthropic engineer Jacob Coxon.

articles.title: L’ONU adverteix que l’avenç de la intel·ligència artificial fa perillar tots els drets humans
articles.summary: UN official Volker Türk warned that rapid advancements in artificial intelligence threaten human rights. He highlighted that advanced systems could endanger essential services, critical infrastructure, and democratic institutions.

articles.title: La ONU advierte que todos los derechos humanos “están en riesgo” ante el avance de la IA
articles.author: Autor Agencias
articles.summary: UN High Commissioner Volker Türk warned that artificial intelligence presents flaws that threaten human rights and could undermine democratic institutions.

articles.title: Un expert en IA desacredita l'alerta dels grans magnats: "És absurd pensar que l'eina pot desenvolupar consciència"
articles.summary: An AI expert dismissed recent warnings from tech magnates who claimed AI could become self-aware and destroy humanity. The expert argues the true risks stem from how systems are currently designed rather than sci-fi scenarios.

articles.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
articles.summary: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.

articles.title: Qué ha pasado con la IA para que sus propios creadores empiecen a temer que pueda escapar a su control
articles.author: Marta Gascón
articles.summary: Concerns over artificial intelligence have surged in recent months, leading its own creators to worry that the technology might escape human control.

articles.title: The risks of AI, according to those who have seen it from the inside: ‘The world is not ready and we are not ready’
articles.author: Patricia Fernández de Lis
articles.summary: Former researchers, executives, and engineers from major AI companies have warned about critical safety failures, military applications, and uncontrollable systems, stating the world is unprepared for these risks.

articles.title: China también pide un sistema de seguridad ante la IA mientras acusa a EE.UU. de difundir mensajes amenazantes
articles.author: Sofía Soler
articles.summary: China has called for an international security and monitoring system to oversee AI development while criticizing US tech firms for spreading alarming messages that hinder global governance.

articles.title: China defiende una IA “orientada al bien” y se opone a narrativas de amenaza o confrontación
articles.author: Autor Agencias
articles.summary: China advocates for AI aimed at the public good while opposing threat narratives, cautioning that misusing the technology could endanger its own political and institutional stability amid competition with the US.

articles.title: Quién gana cuando los dueños de la IA piden que los regulen
articles.author: Esteve Almirall
articles.summary: Tech CEOs including Dario Amodei and Sam Altman are advocating for AI slowdowns and independent safety checks, raising questions about whether regulatory calls serve public safety or corporate self-interest.

articles.title: Teresa Ribera considera “absolutamente preocupantes” los avisos de los gigantes de la IA y aboga por la regulación
articles.author: Antonio M. Vélez
articles.summary: European Commission Vice-President Teresa Ribera expressed strong concern over AI power concentration and supported regulating data centers and AI models to prevent systems from growing out of control.

articles.title: El 'freno' a la IA castiga a ACS y Solaria en el Ibex y arrastra a las tecnológicas asiáticas
articles.author: Economía
articles.summary: Debate over a potential slowdown in artificial intelligence development has caused global stock market drops. Asian tech companies as well as Spanish firms like ACS and Solaria experienced notable losses.

articles.title: Las tecnológicas sufren en bolsa en medio de los temores por el avance de la IA
articles.author: Luis Federico Florio
articles.summary: Technology companies across Europe, the United States, and Asia are experiencing stock market declines due to growing fears surrounding the advancement of artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Sam Altman: “Podríamos perder el control del futuro ante la IA”
articles.author: Francisco Bracero Osuna
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warned that humanity could lose control of the future to AI and highlighted the risk of excessive power concentration within a single government or corporation.

articles.title: China pide una "barrera de seguridad" para la IA ante los intentos de Trump de frenar una regulación global
articles.author: EFE
articles.summary: China's Minister of State Security, Chen Yixin, called for a safety barrier around AI amid global geopolitical competition. China criticized US efforts to restrict its technological advancement, including chip embargoes.

articles.title: La IA, pal de paller de molts nous màsters de casa nostra
articles.author: Esther Escolán
articles.summary: Si hi ha una tecnologia que ha aconseguit revolucionar tots i cadascun dels sectors industrials, empresarials i econòmics a escala global, aquesta ha estat la intel·ligència artificial (IA). Es tracta d’una eina que, entre d'altres, permet automatitzar un gran nombre de…

articles.title: China lanza una alerta sobre los riesgos de la IA en pleno debate sobre los límites de su desarrollo
articles.author: Autor Agencias
articles.summary: China has issued an alert highlighting the risks posed by artificial intelligence amid ongoing debates about setting boundaries on its development. This follows calls from AI firms like OpenAI and Anthropic to slow down advancement.

articles.title: Los cuatro gigantes de la IA piden frenar su desarrollo ante el riesgo de descontrol
articles.author: Marta Gascón
articles.summary: Prominent tech leaders Dario Amodei, Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Demis Hassabis all agree that advanced artificial intelligence development requires stricter controls to prevent a loss of control.

articles.title: La Xina reclama una "barrera de seguretat" per a la IA en ple debat sobre els seus riscos
articles.author: ARA
articles.summary: El ministre xinès de Seguretat de l’Estat, Chen Yixin, ha reclamat la creació d’una "barrera de seguretat" per a la intel·ligència artificial, en un moment de creixent competència tecnològica entre la Xina i els Estats Units. Chen ha situat la IA com un dels principals camps de…

articles.title: Donald Trump es nega a frenar el desenvolupament de la intel·ligència artificial: "Qui guanyi amb la IA, guanya"
articles.summary: Tech leaders are warning about risks from autonomous AI, leading OpenAI CEO Sam Altman to delay the company's IPO. Meanwhile, Donald Trump opposes restricting AI development, framing it as a global race to win.

articles.title: Claus del debat sobre la IA: més veus demanen frenar una tecnologia que pot amenaçar la humanitat
articles.summary: Calls to slow down AI development are growing globally, with China joining demands for caution. Conversely, Donald Trump opposes limits on the technology, viewing it as a competitive global race.

articles.title: Los impulsores de la IA se asustan
articles.author: Jesús Morales
articles.summary: An opinion piece discusses human resilience when facing technological challenges such as artificial intelligence.

stories.headline: Supreme Court blocks Trump's mail-in voting restrictions
stories.summary: The US Supreme Court rejected Trump's attempt to limit mail-in voting ahead of midterms, citing insufficient time for state implementation. The decision preserves current voting rules but does not resolve the legality of Trump's policies. Outlets note the ruling could impact election access for millions.
stories.why_it_matters: The ruling may affect voting access for millions and could influence the outcome of upcoming midterm elections.
key_facts: The Supreme Court rejected Trump's bid to restrict mail-in voting ahead of midterms.
The decision was based on the argument that states did not have enough time to implement new rules.
The court did not specify how many justices voted in favor or against the decision.
The ruling does not settle the legality of Trump's mail-in voting restrictions.

articles.title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump’s plans on postal ballots: Why it matters
articles.summary: Trump has repeatedly criticised mail-in votes and has attempted to restrict them ahead of the midterms.

articles.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump’s restrictions on mail-in voting ahead of midterms
articles.author: Patricia Caro
articles.summary: The Republican’s reform put the votes of millions of people at risk because there wasn’t enough time for the states to implement the new rules

articles.title: El Suprem dels EUA no autoritza l’ordre de Trump contra el vot per correu en les eleccions de mitjan mandat
articles.summary: El tribunal no ha especificat quants magistrats hi han votat a favor i quants en contra

articles.title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump mail ballot restrictions ahead of midterms
articles.summary: US Supreme Court rejects Trump’s bid to tighten mail-in voting rules ahead of critical midterm elections.

articles.title: Nuevo revés del Supremo a Trump: el tribunal rechaza las maniobras para restringir al voto por correo en las legislativas
articles.author: Andrés Gil
articles.summary: La decisión del Supremo mantiene, por ahora, el bloqueo a las maniobras de Trump mientras continúa el litigio sobre el fondo del asunto: la legalidad de la normativa impulsada por el presidente de EEUU El Tribunal Supremo ha rechazado este lunes el intento del presidente de EEUU, Donald Trump, de restringir el voto por correo para las elecciones de mitad de mandato. Con esta decisión, el tribunal, de mayoría conservadora de 6-3, pone fin a una serie de acciones legales que se cruzaban con los preparativos para la votación, que en muchos estados ya están en curso a 50 días de las elecciones. La decisión del Supremo mantiene, por ahora, el bloqueo a las maniobras de Trump mientras continúa el litigio sobre el fondo del asunto: la legalidad de la normativa impulsada por el presidente de EEUU. La decisión permite a los estados seguir enviando papeletas por correo bajo los mismos procedimientos que han utilizado durante años. Los magistrados Samuel Alito y Clarence Thomas han expresado su desacuerdo con la resolución. La Administración Trump había solicitado al tribunal, que se encuentra una vez más en el centro de la controversia política, que allanara el camino a sus restricciones…

articles.title: El Supremo rechaza las restricciones de Trump al voto por correo para las legislativas
articles.author: Patricia Caro
articles.summary: La reforma del republicano ponía en riesgo el sufragio de millones de personas por no haber tiempo suficiente para que los Estados implementaran las nuevas normas

stories.headline: Sánchez targets end-of-year resolution for Ceuta crisis
stories.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has set a goal to stabilize the situation in Ceuta by the end of the year, addressing migration and diplomatic tensions. He dismissed claims of Moroccan blackmail using Pegasus spyware as fake news, while his opacity on the matter has fueled suspicions among allies.
stories.why_it_matters: The situation in Ceuta has significant implications for Spain's migration policy and international relations.
key_facts: Sánchez aims to stabilize Ceuta by the end of the year.
He dismissed Moroccan blackmail claims as fake news.
Over 70,000 migrants arrived in Ceuta in late July.
Sánchez's handling of Morocco has raised suspicions among political allies.

articles.title: Clavijo cree que Sánchez debe "liderar" la respuesta a Ceuta y afea que ni Gobierno ni oposicion han estado "a la altura"
articles.author: RTVE.es
articles.summary: El presidente de las islas Canarias, Fernando Clavijo , ha defendido que el jefe del Ejecutivo central, Pedro Sánchez, debe "liderar" la respuesta a la crisis migratoria de Ceuta , al tiempo que ha afeado que ni el Gobierno nacional ni la oposición han estado "a la altura" de las circunstancias, pues, a su juicio, han estado a "sus peleas". En una entrevista en Las Mañanas de RNE , Clavijo ha asegurado que lo que tenía que haber hecho Sánchez es convocar una Conferencia de Presidentes para ver como "resolver" el problema y dar una "respuesta de país", porque, ha recordado, "los inmigrantes no llegan a Ceuta, llegan a España, a Europa". "Deberíamos dar una respuesta como país y es lo que está faltando. Lo que hay es un presidente en una cadena, y otro en otro, lanzándose reproches", ha criticado Clavijo en alusión a las entrevistas que tanto Sánchez, como el presidente de Ceuta, Juan Jesús Vivas, dieron este lunes en sendas cadenas de televisión. El presidente canario ha abogado por trasladar a los inmigrantes de Ceuta y repartirlos entre las autonomías para hacer los triajes , en lugar de "tenerles retenidos" en la ciudad autónoma, que está soportando, a su juicio, "mucha…

articles.title: Junts esquiva la concreció del rol de Puigdemont quan torni: «Respectarem la seva decisió»
articles.author: Oriol March
articles.summary: El secretari general del partit, Jordi Turull, insisteix en la renúncia de Pedro Sánchez i sosté que no negociaran els pressupostos a Madrid en base a una "enganyifa"

articles.title: La opacidad de Sánchez con Marruecos dispara entre sus socios las sospechas de "chantaje"
articles.author: Alejandro Tobalina, Marta Moreno
articles.summary: Pedro Sánchez's opacity regarding Morocco has raised suspicions of blackmail among his political partners.

articles.title: Sánchez rechaza las teorías sobre un chantaje de Marruecos: "La realidad se tiene que construir en base a hechos y no a bulos"
articles.author: Miguel Muñoz
articles.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez dismissed claims that Morocco is blackmailing his government using Pegasus spyware, calling the rumors fake news. He set a target to restore normality in Ceuta by the end of the year.

articles.title: Sánchez sitúa hasta "finales de año" el mando único en Ceuta para que la situación pueda quedar "estabilizada"
articles.author: RTVE Noticias
articles.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced that single command in Ceuta will remain until year-end to resolve the ongoing migration crisis following the arrival of over 70,000 migrants in late July.

articles.title: Pedro Sánchez: "Nos hemos dado de aquí al final del año para arreglar la situación en Ceuta"
articles.author: José Enrique Monrosi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez expects to resolve the diplomatic and migrant crisis in Ceuta by the end of the year, dismissing claims of Moroccan Pegasus spyware blackmail as persistent rumors.

articles.title: Sumar evita responder a las primarias que ofrece Podemos: "Hay que buscar pactos" pero "la fórmula no nos preocupa"
articles.author: Daniel Ríos
articles.summary: Movimiento Sumar leader Rosa Martínez welcomed Podemos' desire for a joint electoral list but avoided committing to Podemos' proposed open primary process.

articles.title: Irene Montero: "Con unas primarias a las que se pueda presentar todo el mundo tenemos más garantías de acertar"
articles.author: Inés García Rábade
articles.summary: Irene Montero, Podemos' candidate for the 2027 Spanish general election, has called for open primaries to build a unified left-wing ballot. She criticized the current government for failing to address housing speculation and price caps.

articles.title: Irene Montero defiende las primarias abiertas para “salir del bucle” de la izquierda y que la gente “tome la palabra”
articles.author: Paula Chouza Candeira
articles.summary: La eurodiputada, sobre un hipotético chantaje de Marruecos a Sánchez: “Parece bastante evidente que algo hay”

stories.headline: Electoral Board Divided on Supreme Court's Vote Suspension Order
stories.summary: Spain's Central Electoral Board split 7-6 to comply with a Supreme Court ruling suspending voting rights for naturalized citizens under the Grandchildren's Law. The decision includes measures to verify exiled status and adjust census data at consulates.
stories.why_it_matters: The ruling affects over 400,000 citizens' voting rights and highlights tensions between judicial and political branches.
key_facts: The Central Electoral Board voted 7-6 to comply with the Supreme Court's order.
The order suspends voting rights for around 400,000 citizens naturalized under the Grandchildren's Law.
The board requested reports to verify exiled status and adjust census data at consulates.
The Spanish government criticized the Supreme Court's decision as politically motivated.

articles.title: El exministro y expresidente madrileño Ruiz-Gallardón declara este martes como testigo en el primer juicio del caso Lezo
articles.author: RTVE Noticias
articles.summary: Former Justice Minister Alberto Ruiz-Gallardón is testifying as a witness in the Lezo case trial regarding alleged irregularities in Canal de Isabel II's 2001 acquisition of Inassa. Magistrate Manuel García Castellón sent 22 people to trial, including former Madrid officials.

articles.title: El jutge que va titllar el Procés de "cop d'estat encobert" frena ara el dret de vot de la ‘llei de nets’
articles.author: Martí Odriozola i Marcé
articles.summary: Supreme Court judge Antonio Narváez has issued an order blocking voting rights for descendants granted citizenship under Spain's Democratic Memory Law. Narváez previously recused himself from Catalan independence trials in 2021 due to past controversial remarks.

articles.title: El Gobierno se planta tras el discurso de la presidenta del Supremo y la suspensión judicial de la 'ley de nietos': "No nos vamos a callar"
articles.author: Miguel Muñoz
articles.summary: Tensions have escalated between the Spanish government and top judicial officials following the court suspension of voting rights under the 'grandchild law'. Government ministers criticized judicial corporatism after Supreme Court President Isabel Perelló denounced political attacks against magistrates.

articles.title: Fractura en la Junta Electoral: del "despropósito" del fallo de la ley de nietos a evitar el pulso con el Supremo
articles.author: Elena Herrera, José Enrique Monrosi
articles.summary: Spain's Central Electoral Board decided in a divided 7-6 vote to comply with a Supreme Court ruling that suspends voting rights for around 400,000 citizens naturalized under the Grandchildren's Law.

articles.title: La Junta Electoral evita el xoc amb el Suprem i acata el mandat sobre la llei de nets
articles.summary: The Spanish government criticized the Supreme Court's decision to suspend voting rights under the Grandchildren's Law, claiming political intent behind the ruling.

articles.title: Manel Pérez: “El Supremo ha abierto un conflicto al retirar el derecho de voto a españoles reconocidos por la ley de nietos”
articles.author: Martí Paola
articles.summary: La Vanguardia's deputy director Manel Pérez criticized the Supreme Court's injunction stripping voting rights from 400,000 citizens naturalized under the Grandchildren's Law.

articles.title: La Junta Electoral ejecuta dividida la orden del Supremo sobre la 'ley de nietos'
articles.author: Agencias
articles.summary: Spain's Central Electoral Board voted 7-6 to comply with the Supreme Court's injunction regarding the Grandchildren's Law while requesting reports to verify exiled status.

articles.title: Óscar López critica a los jueces "salvapatrias" y califica de "salvajada" la decisión de suspender el derecho al voto de miles de españoles
articles.author: Europa Press
articles.summary: Public Function Minister Óscar López strongly denounced the Supreme Court's ruling to suspend voting rights for over 400,000 descendants of Spanish exiles.

articles.title: La JEC ejecuta el requerimiento del Supremo sobre la ley de nietos sin compartir su criterio
articles.author: Asier Martiarena Olveira
articles.summary: The Central Electoral Board agreed to carry out the Supreme Court's order on the Grandchildren's Law without endorsing the court's legal reasoning.

articles.title: La Junta Electoral evita el choque con el Supremo y acuerda dividida trasladar a los consulados el freno al censo de la ley de nietos
articles.author: Elena Herrera
articles.summary: The Central Electoral Board approved by a narrow majority to enforce the Supreme Court's order requiring consulates to break down census data for Grandchildren's Law applicants.

articles.title: La Junta Electoral acata dividida el mandato del Supremo sobre la ‘ley de nietos’
articles.author: Javier Casqueiro Barreiro
articles.summary: La mayoría de los vocales no comparten que se haya suspendido el derecho al voto de los nacionalizados sin permitir alegaciones

articles.title: La Junta Electoral acata la orden del TS y revisará que los nacionalizados a través de la 'ley de nietos' tengan vínculo con el exilio
articles.author: 20minutos |
articles.summary: El organismo electoral pedirá informes al Censo y a los registros consulares para comprobar qué beneficiarios cumplen los requisitos fijados por el alto tribunal para votar desde el extranjero.

articles.title: El judici als quatre antifeixistes d’Alacant “busca fer callar la contestació” als actes de VOX, segons Alerta Solidària

stories.headline: Leaders from Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland unite for self-determination
stories.summary: Leaders from Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland have signed a declaration supporting self-determination. They argue that Westminster has no right to block democratic processes and demand constitutional reform. The leaders called for an end to the current political relationship with the UK.
stories.why_it_matters: This agreement could reshape the political landscape of the UK and its relationship with its constituent nations.
key_facts: Leaders from Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland signed a declaration supporting self-determination.
They argue that Westminster has no right to block democratic processes.
The leaders called for constitutional reform and an equal relationship among nations.
The declaration was signed by the first ministers of the three regions.

stories.headline: Israeli NGO accuses government of pursuing 'elimination' project in West Bank
stories.summary: An Israeli NGO claims Israeli authorities are using violence, mobility restrictions, and economic pressure to undermine Palestinian life in the West Bank. Multiple sources report that these actions are part of a coordinated effort to erode Palestinian collective existence. Some outlets note that the strategy has intensified since the formation of Netanyahu's government in 2022.
stories.why_it_matters: The alleged 'elimination project' could have long-term consequences for Palestinian society and its ability to sustain itself in the occupied territories.
key_facts: Israeli NGO B’Tselem accuses the government of implementing a 'project of elimination' in the West Bank.
The strategy includes violence, mobility barriers, and economic hardship to undermine Palestinian life.
The approach has intensified since the formation of Netanyahu's government in 2022.
The NGO argues that these actions collectively aim to dismantle Palestinian collective existence.

articles.title: 'Proyecto eliminación': el plan de Israel para hacer la vida imposible a los palestinos de Cisjordania
articles.author: Francesca Cicardi
articles.summary: La organización israelí B'Tselem denuncia en un nuevo informe el "proyecto" que busca desmantelar la sociedad palestina en los territorios ocupados, que se ha acelerado desde la formación en 2022 del Gobierno ultraderechista de Benjamín Netanyahu Tropas israelíes expulsan de sus casas a familias palestinas tras el asedio de colonos: “Un intento meticuloso de limpieza étnica” Desde ir al trabajo o a la escuela, recibir tratamiento médico u otros servicios, hasta visitar a familiares o amigos y tener una casa y un terreno para cultivar se han convertido en actividades complicadas y peligrosas para los más de 3 millones de palestinos que viven bajo la ocupación israelí en Cisjordania. Aunque esta realidad no es nueva, ha degenerado desde la formación del actual Gobierno a finales de 2022 y, especialmente, a partir del 7 de octubre de 2023 —cuando dio comienzo el genocidio en Gaza, a raíz del ataque del grupo Hamás de ese día—. La ONG israelí B'Tselem ha reunido en un amplio informe todas las violaciones que sufren los palestinos en su día a día, en el marco de los que califica de “ataque combinado” contra los individuos y contra toda la sociedad, con el objetivo de eliminar “las…

articles.title: Israel lleva a cabo un "proyecto de eliminación" de la población palestina en Cisjordania, según la ONG israelí B'Tselem
articles.author: Ana Garralda
articles.summary: La violencia de soldados y colonos, los puestos de control, el cierre de escuelas o la apropiación de tierras suelen quedar registrados como episodios distintos de la ocupación israelí en Cisjordania. Pero, la ONG israelí B'Tselem sostiene que, leídos juntos, revelan un mismo engranaje: un "proyecto de eliminación" dirigido a deshacer las condiciones que permiten a los palestinos mantenerse como sociedad en Cisjordania y, en paralelo, a consolidar una presencia israelí continua y permanente. Es la conclusión de un informe de 249 páginas publicado este lunes por esta organización de derechos humanos. Titulado "El proyecto de eliminación: el desmantelamiento sistemático israelí de la vida colectiva palestina en Cisjordania" , se basa en cerca de 2.000 testimonios , trabajo de campo, documentos oficiales y datos de Naciones Unidas y otras ONG. El estudio incluye Jerusalén Este y analiza la vida de unos 3,5 millones de palestinos. El documento sitúa la aceleración de este proceso en la llegada al poder de la actual coalición, a finales de 2022, y en el 7 de octubre de 2023.
